articles.summary: BETHESDA, Md., May 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- DiamondRock Hospitality Company (the "Company") announced today the sale of its leasehold interest in the 189-room Courtyard by Marriott New York Manhattan/Fifth Avenue (the "Hotel") for $33.0 million. The sales price represents a 6.3x multiple on 2025
articles.title: DIAMONDROCK HOSPITALITY COMPANY ANNOUNCES SALE OF THE COURTYARD BY MARRIOTT NEW YORK MANHATTAN/FIFTH AVENUE
